concepts.def: Technology in daily life, including computers, smartphones and the internet.
Social media used to communicate, share content and stay in touch with friends.
The mobile phone, used for messaging, calls and going online.
The world around us and environmental issues such as pollution and climate change.
Recycling and reducing waste to protect the environment.
The media, including news, advertising and online information.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us — a core area of GCSE German.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
